messages:
lee: kicked off v2.4.8 canary at 09:12 UTC for routes: embed-eu, generate-us. quick flag: model variant for embed-eu -> modelx:quant3.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 0% -> 100% in 7m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3490012345 :robot_face:
tara: heads up, smoke dashboard flashed a prefill latency bump on eu-west1 embed-kv-prefill probe at +3m. p95 from 95ms -> 420ms briefly.
oncall: runbook threshold: if synth p95 > 300ms for >90s, hold and consider regional pin. also check kv-miss % and prefill retries.
lee: pulling traces and kv-miss trend now.
smoke-bot: running immediate rerun of embed-kv-prefill in eu-west1 (id r-349-01). ETA ~35s.
infra: small note — quant3 uses async prefetch ordering; might reprioritize late-prefill slots.
smoke-bot: rerun results: p50 38ms, p95 410ms, kv-miss +22%, prefill retries increased x3. :warning:
tara: that aligns with prefills timing out and trying again. real user generate route doesn't show errors but tail latency visible.
lee: I'm going to regional-pin embed-eu in eu-west1 back to modelx:fp16 while we triage. command: `rdctl routes pin --route embed-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --reason "postdeploy prefill tail spike"`
deploy-bot: ACK. applying pin...
deploy-bot: Route config patched; rolloutid r-2026-11-04-3490.
smoke-bot: running quick smoke after pin... results: p95 112ms, kv-miss +2%, retries back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
oncall: good, hold global rollout for 20m observation window per runbook. please add a short note to release notes and open an infra ticket for prefetch ordering investigation.
tara: adding release note: "v2.4.8: temporary regional pin in eu-west1 to fp16 after prefill tail latency observed with quant3 during canary; investigation open."
lee: filing ticket: https://tracker.redwood.internal/INFRA-12901 (quant3 prefetch ordering -> causes kv-prefill tail). attaching traces and smoke runs.
infra: will prioritize repro in staging and test alternate async prefetch backoffs.
lee: leaving thread open for 20m; will close if no regression. thx all. :thumbsup:
